title: PAC-Bayes Beyond Parameter Space: Behavioral Equivalence, Z-Information, and Exact Complexity Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2608.11465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: PAC-Bayes theory provides generalization guarantees by controlling the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between posterior and prior distributions over a chosen hypothesis representation. However, predictive risk depends only on the predictive behavior induced by a hypothesis, not on the particular internal realization that implements that behavior. In over-parameterized systems, many distinct configurations induce identical predictive behavior, yet the classical PAC-Bayes KL divergence does not distinguish uncertainty over predictive behavior from variation among behaviorally equivalent realizations.   We show that this distinction induces an exact structural decomposition of classical PAC-Bayes complexity. translated_title: 超越参数空间的PAC-Bayes：行为等价性、Z信息与精确复杂度分解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11465v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：PAC-Bayes理论通过控制所选假设表示上后验分布与先验分布之间的库尔贝克-莱布勒（KL）散度来提供泛化保证。然而，预测风险仅取决于假设所引发的预测行为，而非实现该行为的特定内部实现方式。在过参数化系统中，许多不同配置会引发相同的预测行为，但经典PAC-Bayes KL散度并不区分关于预测行为的不确定性与行为等价实现之间的变化。我们表明，这种区分引出了经典PAC-Bayes复杂度的精确结构分解。我们通过可测行为映射形式化行为等价性，并利用测度分解将配置空间上的概率测度分解为预测行为上的分布和条件分布。
tldr: 本文通过行为等价性将PAC-Bayes复杂度精确分解为预测行为不确定性与行为等价实现变化两部分，揭示了过参数化系统中经典KL散度的结构局限。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes PAC-Bayes complexity exactly into predictive behavior uncertainty and variation among behaviorally equivalent realizations, revealing structural limitations of classical KL divergence in over-parameterized systems.
